d: Mom makes a fantastic Christmas dinner  the boys are delighted that Grandma is coming, but horrified that Dad's mother is coming too.

Dad has been secretly hiding a dead fox he wants to get stuffed in the outside freezer, however, when Mom needs to use the freezer, Dad enlists Adam and Jonny in a desperate attempt to hide the dead animal from her.

The family is distraught when Grandma gets engaged to Mr. Morris, her horrible 85-year-old boyfriend  meanwhile, Jim collects money for charity, while dressed in full dog costume, complete with doggy testicles.
When Dad buys a piano, the world's most sarcastic piano tuner comes to tune it  meanwhile, the family catches Aunty Val having an affair.
Dad accidentally invites someone he used to hate to dinner and faces the dilemma of how to get rid of his guest.
Everyone rushes to clean up an oil spill on Mom's beloved carpet.
Adam is finally recognized for his musical talent, but is overshadowed when Jonny arrives home and announces he's gotten married.
When Adam stays with his parents all week, he begins behaving like a little boy again  Jim finally passes his driving test -- after 15 attempts.
The boys come home to find a For Sale sign in front of the house and immediately look for ways to stop their parents from selling the family home.
Mom and dad get a hot tub, but Adam and Jonny aren't keen on the idea.
Adam is not happy when he is forced to play his violin for Mum and her best friend Val.
The boys are threatened with no crumble if they don't help to assemble a wooden shelf.
Dad buys a grotty caravan  Jim's got a new dog  and the boys have new "females."
Martin becomes obsessed with a plastic bag that's stuck up a tree.
